h: NDC unveils 2027 campaign council with Seriake Dickson as chair and Peter Obi as co-chair
p: The NDC has named its campaign council for the 2027 elections, with former Bayelsa governor Henry Seriake Dickson as chairman and presidential candidate Peter Obi as co-chair. The party is building its structure as the campaign season picks up across the country.
more: The announcement comes as the party deals with discipline cases, including the sacking of a Borno candidate.
All the major parties are now naming campaign teams.
